podcast.body: Released in 1993, this song was noted for its similarity to the Red Hot Chili Peppers' "Dani California." Tom Petty, however, downplayed any "negative intent," stating that "a lot of rock and roll songs sound alike" and expressing disinterest in frivolous lawsuits over pop songs. "This is a clip of a Tom Petty song called Mary Jane's Last Dance, which was released in 1993."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was released in 1993 and was later compared to the Red Hot Chili Peppers' song "Dani California" from their 2006 *Stadium Arcadium* album due to similar sounds. Petty expressed doubt about "any negative intent here," noting that "a lot of rock and roll songs sound alike," and stated he doesn't "believe in lawsuits much." "I seriously doubt there is any negative intent here. And a lot of rock and roll songs sound alike."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
